aggregation function

  • CURIE: gmeow:aggregationFunction
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/aggregationFunction
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/aggregation

The statistical function applied to the entities in the aggregation region — count, sum, average, density, minimum, maximum, or centroid.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:SpatialAggregation -> gmeow:AggregationFunction; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:aggregationFunction from gmeow:SpatialAggregation to gmeow:AggregationFunction when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:SpatialAggregation, gmeow:AggregationFunction
